description: Change the shared event everyone sees on the RSVP page: title, date/time, place or description. Only after the group agreed. Times are local (no time zone); omit start_time for an all-day event. Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a field. Current stored state is available through get_plan. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: explain that lesgooo is not available to them. Do not write another known underage child's personal data, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, IDs, passwords or verification codes. Offer ordinary non-sensitive planning text instead; do not replace a restricted request with an unrequested plan.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.
